items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, they was looking for Miles for direction at all times.

ctx.x: Yeah, they played the charts really good.
Mr. Davis. It was great that Jimmy is here to pull the little bits. Everybody gets to reacquaint themselves with that. He changed music, Miles. Every decade he did something completely . . .
Yeah, they was looking for Miles for direction at all times.
